user.title: Choose translation services
user.description: Selected phrases are translated through these accounts. With several services you choose the preferred one here and can switch per translation later.

discovery_confirm.title: Custom Integration Translator
discovery_confirm.description: Translate missing phrases in your custom integrations with DeepL or Google Translate, whichever you have set up. Review source and target text, select phrases and protect product names before translating. Set up the translator now?

abort.provider_required: Set up a translation service first ({providers}), then try again.

error.provider_required: No translation service is currently available. Set up or enable DeepL Translator or Google Translator, then try again.

preferences.title: Language and sidebar
preferences.description: Choose “system” to follow the Home Assistant system language.

deactivate.title: Disable the translator?
deactivate.description: By default all translations are kept. Select the option to first restore originals and remove files created solely by the translator. {detail}

automation.title: Automatic checks
automation.description: Turn off automatic checks to use the workspace manually only. Individual trigger choices and the interval are kept for later. These settings do not change translation files.

data.watch_hacs: Check after HACS installations and removals
data.watch_marketplace: Check after Marketplace installations and removals
data.scan_loaded: Check when a custom integration loads
data.scan_language: Check when the system language changes

data_description.scan_interval_hours: 168 hours = once a week; 0 disables the periodic check. The selected event triggers stay active while automatic checks are enabled.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: New setups show missing translations quietly in the overview sensor. Individual notifications and Repairs issues can be enabled here. Saving removes disabled suggestions; recovery dialogs remain available.

data.repair_missing: Create Repairs issues for missing phrases

providers.title: Translation services
providers.description: Choose the account of each service. The preferred service is used unless you pick another one while translating. With the takeover enabled, another service translates when the chosen one cannot, for example because its quota is used up or it does not offer the language.

data.provider_fallback: Let another service take over on failure

abort.provider_unavailable: Set up or enable DeepL Translator or Google Translator, then try again.

error.restore_failed: Cleanup stopped. Review the affected file in the workspace.

open_workspace.name: Open translations
open_workspace.description: Open the workspace in the calling administrator’s visible browser. Automations without a user context create a notification with a link.

missing.title: {name} · {count} missing phrases ({language})
missing.description: The existing translation is missing source phrases. [Review and add phrases]({url})

review.title: Keep translations?
review.description: The translator was disabled or removed. The managed language files were kept. Leave the box unchecked to keep the files. Undoing changes restores originals and removes generated files. {detail}
